question: Town Q is to the south of Town R. Town S is to the east of Town R. Town T is to the north of Town S. Town U is to the east of Town T. Town V is to the north-east of Town U. What is the position of Town V with respect to Town Q?
solution:
Given:

 
• Town Q is to the south of Town R.
 
• Town S is to the east of Town R.
 
• Town T is to the north of Town S.
 
• Town U is to the east of Town T.
 
• Town V is to the north-east of Town U
